schemaNotes.figmaMixed: FIGMA_MIXED marks mixed property values. Use textSegments for exact styled runs.
schemaNotes.paint: Figma RGB channels range from 0 to 1. Paint opacity and layer opacity are stored independently.
schemaNotes.autoLayout: NONE is the observed layout mode for every frame and instance in scope.
